A thank-you to the photographers

This is an imagined itinerary, not a record of a personal trip. All photographs come from Wikimedia Commons, not a private camera roll. Captions and vector illustrations were newly authored for this book. The photographs retain their original licences; no endorsement is implied.

Illustrations are synthetic, shape-by-shape SVG interpretations, not embedded or traced photos. Each is offered under the corresponding photograph’s licence above. Source records: sources.json · Traveller’s notes: notes.md.

How this was made

Following “Turn Trip Photos Into a Digital Sketchbook” by Nelson Lee. The method: prepare photos, write notes, build and check the cover and first spread, complete the book, then refine individual illustrations.

Substitution: this implementation uses code-authored SVG and vanilla JavaScript rather than the guide’s Claude Code / Opus workflow. No paid image service, image generation API or external JavaScript library was used. Caveat is the single handwritten Google Font.

Photos were saved as numbered JPEGs at 1600px on the long edge with metadata removed, including GPS. Originals were preserved privately in the build folder. Their capture dates span different years; this book deliberately follows an imagined route rather than claiming one chronological trip. Original colours inspired each drawing’s limited marker palette. Small vector pigment flecks provide paper grain.
